    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v == 4 for v in grid[r])]

        out[r] = [4 if grid[src][c] == 4 else 0 for c in range(w)]

    return out
